parameters.content:
## Request Quote Draft

HONEST SIMPLIFICATION, not a full implementation: HubSpot's native Quotes API requires a quoteTemplateId and real line-item/product IDs from your portal, which aren't available yet. Rather than guess at those and risk creating a malformed or wrong-priced quote, this tool creates a Deal (if needed) and a clearly-flagged note capturing exactly what the customer wants — for a human to turn into a real Quote.

This is a deliberate stand-in for the real Workflow C (human approval + native Quote creation) that hasn't been built yet. The mandatory-human-review property (Rule 9) is satisfied by the fact that NOTHING gets sent to the customer from this tool at all — a human must act on the flagged note before anything reaches them.

needs_review guard still applies on top of this, for identity-certainty reasons independent of the quote-approval requirement itself.

parameters.jsCode: return { json: { success: false, reason: 'Contact identity is pending manual review — quote request was not logged. Do not tell the customer a quote is coming yet.' } };

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ properties: { dealname: ($('When Executed by AI Agent').package_name || 'Package') + ' - quote requested', dealstage: 'presentationscheduled', pipeline: 'default' }, associations: [ { to: { id: $('When Executed by AI Agent').item.json.hubspot_contact_id}, types: [ { associationCategory: 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED', associationTypeId: 3 } ] } ] }) }}

nodes.name: Create Deal
nodes.notes: dealstage/pipeline values ('presentationscheduled'/'default') are HubSpot's out-of-the-box internal names — verify against your actual portal's pipeline configuration if you've customized stages, per Rule 3. associationTypeId 3 is the standard deal-to-contact association.

nodes.name: Flag Note for Human Quote Creation
nodes.notes: This note is the actual HITL gate for this tool (Rule 9) — nothing reaches the customer until a human acts on it. Runs regardless of whether Create Deal succeeded, so the flag still exists even if the deal creation had an issue.

nodes.name: Send Slack Notification
nodes.notes: Plain message, not interactive buttons — deliberately avoids building full Slack app interactivity (real security/setup cost) for a portfolio-scale project. The link opens the n8n Form where the actual approval happens. YOUR_N8N_HOST and the Slack channel ID are placeholders — verify against your real n8n instance URL and Slack workspace before running.
